name: Image Bandwidth Calculator
description: Estimate data transfer and bandwidth requirements for serving images.
search_intent: Estimate image bandwidth usage from file size, page views and image count.
calculation: Data per view = average image size KB × images per view. Total transfer KB = data per view × page views. Convert to MB and GB using a clearly documented binary or decimal convention and use it consistently.
limitations: This estimates image payload only and excludes HTML, CSS, JavaScript, video and API traffic.
Browser caching, CDN caching, compression and repeat visits can materially change actual bandwidth usage.
